methodology_details.label: Reported CDS spread
methodology_details.aggregation: Daily median of eligible direct public reports by UTC execution date; count means reports, not independently verified unique economic trades.
methodology_details.maturity_bucket: 4–6 remaining years at execution; no synthetic 5Y normalization

notation_verification.detail: Current DTCC SEC Message Specification and PPD Transformation/Scaling Help require login. Public raw Spread-Leg notation and economic meaning are not both certified; no basis-point value is inferred.

methodology_details.lifecycle_policy: Identical repeated reports deduplicated; conflicting IDs and entire amended/error chains excluded conservatively.
methodology_details.timestamps: Event timestamp is the source event time, not a dissemination/publication time. The selected public fields contain no certified dissemination timestamp; publication latency is unavailable and is never derived from event minus execution time.
methodology_details.record_order: Latest/recent report records are ordered by source_event_timestamp, not public dissemination order. latest_spread_report is selected by execution_timestamp, with source event time only as a tie-breaker.
methodology_details.source_file_date: source_files.date identifies the UTC day of the cumulative public dissemination file; it does not establish a precise dissemination timestamp or publication latency.
limitations: Public reports are not a dealer close or authenticated par-spread quotation.
Documentation clause is not established by selected public fields; no cross-documentation adjustment is made.
No certified dissemination timestamp is available in the selected source fields; publication delay remains null regardless of event and execution timestamps.
Online runs refresh today and the prior two UTC source dates; older cached snapshots can miss later source republications until refreshed explicitly.
Build timestamp does not imply a fresh source file or recent trade.
